title: Ceban Pertama
alt: Bagi tagihan tongkrongan tanpa ribet, tanpa keselip.
desc: Ceban Pertama is a mobile-first web application designed to simplify shared bill splitting for group dining, travel, and social hangouts. By allowing users to upload a photo of a physical receipt or input items manually, the platform automates line-item breakdown, weighted portion allocation, and proportional tax (PB1) and service charge distribution. Participants can view their exact individual shares, access payment destination details (Indonesian bank accounts, or e-wallets), and track settlement status in real time via shareable WhatsApp links without requiring mandatory account registration.
stack: Next.Js • Tailwind • PostgreSQL• Better Auth • Gemini AI

title: Watchme.log
alt: Never lose your place. Never miss an airdate.
desc: WatchMe.log was born from a very common frustration: frequently switching streaming accounts or sharing profiles, only to lose your watch history and forget exactly which episode you were on. This app acts as your personal, independent watch log where a single tap on an episode number bookmarks your exact progress across any season—ensuring that no matter what streaming platform or account you log into, you never lose your place again.
stack: React Vite • Tailwind • PostgreSQL•  TMDB API

title: UIUX Bayarin Mobile
alt: Scan QR, Pesan Menu, Langsung Bayar.
desc: Bayarin Mobile is a mobile-first UI design crafted for seamless restaurant self-ordering, featuring a high-contrast layout, warm appetite-stimulating accents, and an ergonomic thumb-zone hierarchy. The interface prioritizes speed and clarity through modular menu cards, quick-filter chips, a sticky cart summary, and clean transactional states—from dynamic QRIS checkout to automated WhatsApp receipt confirmation.
